resolved_dispute.client_claim: I hired the freelancer to deliver a responsive landing page by Friday. I paid the full 500 USDT deposit up front. The deadline passed and no working page was delivered — only a single static screenshot. I want my deposit refunded.
resolved_dispute.reasoning_summary: The evidence is unrelated boilerplate repo files and does not prove delivery, deadline compliance, or nonperformance. Claims are unsupported, so the dispute is inconclusive.
resolved_dispute.respondent_claim: I delivered the landing page on time and sent the link plus a demo video. The client stopped responding and never confirmed receipt. The work is complete, so the deposit should be released to me, not refunded.
